ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Vsls-Agent Command With AgentExtensionPath Load
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Microsoft Visual Studio vsls-agent.exe lolbin execution with a suspicious library load using the --agentExtensionPath parameter

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\vsls\\-agent\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-agentExtensionPath.*")) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\.VisualStudio\\\.LiveShare\\\.Agent\\\..*"))
